issues.description: Element: Animal#getName() and Animal#setName(String). Problem statement: the UML and task note explicitly specify these accessor methods should have protected visibility (UML uses '#' and the task text states: "implement the name getter and setter with protected visibility"). Solution: in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Animal.java both methods are implemented as public (signatures: public String getName() and public void setName(String)). This visibility mismatch between the specification and the provided solution code can confuse students about intended encapsulation and may lead to grading or test discrepancies.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the accessor methods match the specification: change the visibility of getName() and setName(String) to protected in the solution (and in any provided template). If public access was intended instead, update the UML and the task note in the problem statement to state the methods are public so all artifacts are consistent.

issues.suggestedFix: Change the Animal(String) constructor visibility in the solution (and template if present) to protected to match the UML and problem statement.
